facts.text: College of the Atlantic offers only one single degree—human ecology—allowing every student to design their own individualized curriculum integrating sciences, arts, and humanities.

sources.title: Why Choose College of the Atlantic | Human Ecology & Experiential ...
sources.quote: Founded in 1969 as the first—and only—college where every student designs a self-directed major in human ecology, COA blends disciplines, experiences, and community to prepare graduates for meaningful impact.
